method.direction: Backward citation snowballing (references cited by each paper)
method.generation_1: All PubMed-indexed references linked by NIH iCite from the 240 seeds
method.generation_2: All PubMed-indexed references linked from every unique generation-1 paper
method.generation_3: References from a relevance-gated generation-2 frontier, capped at 2500
method.third_generation_gate: CalorType temperature/variant/mechanism terminology, seed-associated gene matching, graph support, and top leads per seed
method.shortlist_threshold: Relevance score >= 4; seeds already present in set 2 excluded

coverage_limitations: Citation links are limited to PubMed/NIH Open Citation Collection identifiers; non-PubMed references may be absent.
Generation 3 is deliberately selective to prevent uncontrolled combinatorial expansion.
Ranking is a high-recall machine triage based on titles, available abstracts, seed-gene matches, and graph support; it is not a substitute for full-text review.
Forward citations are not included in this build.
